method: 70 city footprints whose BLDGNOTE begins 'Jefferson Lab' used verbatim as one MultiPolygon, excluding the buildings drawn on their own records (halls, tunnel strips, service buildings) and building 12 (CEBAF Center, drawn from OpenStreetMap on geometry:jlab-cebaf-center-building; the two independent outlines' centroids are 6.8 m apart and their areas, 5221 m2 (city) and 5262 m2 (OSM), differ by 0.8%). Numbers follow the lab's site-plan list (for example #85 Machine Control Center, #58 Test Lab, #55 TED, #18 LERF).
